authority: Desktop owns native command names, import dialogs and file selection. Shared bodies come from yijie-contracts skills/market-v2.

skills_import_v2.response: Operation or null when picker is cancelled
skills_import_v2.inputAuthority: Native picker-owned regular file, bounded read and SHA-256; no renderer path or bytes

skills_prepare_import_v2.response: {id, name} or null when picker is cancelled
skills_prepare_import_v2.inputAuthority: Native picker or single-use native drop receipt in the active dialog. A successful read replaces its in-memory selection. Cancellation or read failure preserves the previous selection.

skills_confirm_import_v2.inputAuthority: Current selection from the same dialog. The selection ID is the Host operation ID for every retry of its bound bytes and SHA-256.

skills_close_import_v2.effect: Release only the matching dialog, its selection, drop receipt and channel.

admission: Exact local managed profile and paired Runtime artifact; request authorization remains in Native and Host
